notes.title: Ver.1.2.1 Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the error of changing to common mode after re challenging in challenge mode

2. Adjust the release timing of cache for enemy aircraft, dropped objects, etc., to reduce the impact of certain errors in the previous game on the new game

notes.title: Ver.1.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
1. Add follow-up levels after defeating Boss Andema, including enemies in the path and Boss Half werewolf Ora at the bottom of the level

2. Increase plot dialogue and supplement game world information. Add ending plot content to the game

3. Add BGM to the title interface

notes.title: Ver.1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
1. Redesigned UI interface including difficulty selection and mode selection interface

2. All regular enemy planes have been replaced with recognizable styles and have simple frame animations

3. Optimize the rendering of 3D backgrounds to reduce performance pressure in some hardware environments

4. Optimize barrage collision logic, reduce ineffective collisions and repetitive damage

5. Adjusted the distribution of health and dropped items for all enemy planes, including Boss

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.0 Update Information
notes.notes:
1. Optimized the issue of low firepower coverage of the prop "scattered bullets" and almost empty bullets when attacking bosses

2. Fixed an error in the game where the default selected option changed due to input caching when the interface popped up after death

3. Added challenge mode (the mode selection interface is open after players complete any difficulty level):

    - In challenge mode, players can only withstand damage from barrage or enemy once per life

    - In challenge mode, the yellow line boundary for absorbing points/props above has been increased

    - In challenge mode, when the score reaches a certain amount during the settlement of each level, an additional reward of one life will be given
